notes: S2-FIX3 F72 (§5.3: a record supplies key material only when it passes every check other than the §9.4 effects on its subject key's signature): a human declaration recorded at T1, cosigned by human-2 (a keyset root) and carrying a further signature by a key that nothing declares. The declaration is unverifiable E_KEY_UNKNOWN (§14.5 step (4)), so it is not semantically valid and supplies no material: a note signed by the declared key at T2 is unverifiable E_KEY_UNKNOWN, although human-2's cosignature verified.
